n.story:
In your role, AI acts as a silent 'digital supervisor' rather than a replacement. While the core of your work remains deeply physical—chopping, cleaning, and preparing food—AI-powered computer vision systems now assist you by monitoring stock levels in real-time and flagging when a surface needs sanitizing or when food waste is exceeding targets. You no longer need to manually count boxes in the freezer; the system does it for you, allowing you to focus on the precision of your prep work.

Your value is anchored in your physical dexterity and sensory judgment. AI cannot smell if a sauce is burning or feel the texture of perfectly kneaded dough. However, you will become more effective by using AI-driven waste reduction indicators to change how you prep ingredients, making the kitchen more sustainable. The job remains stable because the 'last mile' of food preparation requires a human hand that robots still cannot cost-effectively replicate in a cramped, high-heat environment.
